sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Stafford Town on Saturday 28 November looking to build on their most recent win. Sandbach sit top of the table with 37 points from 17 games and have won two of their last three league matches, though they did suffer back-to-back losses before their recent upturn. Stafford Town, currently fourth with 32 points, will provide a stern test for the visitors.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals are in exceptional form with six consecutive league wins and face a home fixture against Dawley Town on Saturday before travelling to New Mills on Tuesday. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday as they continue their strong campaign. Eccleshall, fifth in the table, travel to Barnton on Saturday in what looks a competitive mid-table encounter. Allscott Heath welcome Crewe at home on Saturday before facing a tougher away trip to Widnes Town on Tuesday. The bottom end of the division sees several struggling sides in action: Foley Meir host New Mills on Saturday; Brereton Social visit Alsager Town on Saturday; Telford Town host Widnes Town on Saturday; and Wednesfield Community, in difficult form, host Shawbury United on Saturday before travelling to Barnton on Tuesday. Barnton also face a midweek fixture against Wednesfield after their Saturday game against Eccleshall.
